history.summary: A keyword-titled 'D5 freehold cheap 3 bed' — a 2027-TOP freehold 3BR essentially at Haw Par Villa MRT (the '1m' is a data artefact, but the project is clearly MRT-adjacent) at $2.48M / $2259 PSF. Freehold + doorstep MRT in D05 is a genuinely strong location pairing, but $2259 PSF is full new-launch pricing and the project identity is masked, so there is no value cushion or URA data to confirm the rate.
history.rating_rationale: Genuine strengths: freehold tenure, doorstep Haw Par Villa MRT (CC line), D05/West Coast in the One-North/GSW corridor. But $2259 PSF is full launch price with no margin, the project name is hidden behind a 'cheap' marketing hook (and $2259 PSF is not actually cheap for the unit), built 2027 means TOP/market risk before exit, and there is no URA appreciation/txn data. Score 572 is moderately above market. A fair-priced freehold near MRT, not a discounted buy.
